entries.title: Psalms 77:1
segments: To the Chief Musician. To Jeduthun. A Psalm of Asaph. I cried to God with my voice, to God [is] my voice; and He gave ear to me.

entries.title: Psalms 77:2
segments: In the day of my trouble I sought the LORD; my hand was poured in the night, and ceased not; my soul refused to be comforted.

entries.title: Psalms 77:3
segments: I remembered God, and was troubled; I complained, and my spirit fainted. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 77:4
segments: You keep my eyes awake; I am troubled and I cannot speak.

entries.title: Psalms 77:5
segments: I have thought on the days of old, the years of ages [past].

entries.title: Psalms 77:6
segments: I remember my song in the night; I speak with my own heart, and my spirit carefully searches.

entries.title: Psalms 77:7
segments: Will the Lord cast off forever? And will He be favorable no more?

entries.title: Psalms 77:8
segments: Is His mercy gone forever? Has [His] word failed for all generations?

entries.title: Psalms 77:9
segments: Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has He in anger shut up His tender mercies? Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 77:10
segments: And I said, This [is] my weakness, the years of the right hand of the Most High.

entries.title: Psalms 77:11
segments: I will remember the works of the LORD; surely I will remember Your wonders of old.

entries.title: Psalms 77:12
segments: I will also think on all Your work, and talk of Your doings.

entries.title: Psalms 77:13
segments: Your way, O God, [is] in holiness; who [is] so great a God as our God?

entries.title: Psalms 77:14
segments: You [are] the God who does wonders; You have declared Your strength among the people.

entries.title: Psalms 77:15
segments: You have with [Your] arm redeemed Your people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 77:16
segments: The waters saw You, O God, the waters saw You; they were afraid; the depths also were troubled.

entries.title: Psalms 77:17
segments: The clouds poured out water; the skies sent out a sound; Your arrows also flew here and there.

entries.title: Psalms 77:18
segments: The voice of Your thunder [was] in the sky; the lightnings lit up the world; the earth trembled and shook.

entries.title: Psalms 77:19
segments: Your way [is] in the sea, and Your path in the great waters, and Your footsteps are not known.

entries.title: Psalms 77:20
segments: You led Your people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
